verdict.rationale: Docs confirm hardware can be ordered, registered, and managed directly from the Stripe Dashboard (docs-32, docs-5, docs-20, docs-43) and that no-code acceptance is possible without a custom integration (docs-21, docs-26, docs-31), supporting a fast, self-serve path to in-person payments. However, the evidence pack has no explicit detail on the account sign-up/approval workflow or timeline claims (e.g., approval speed, KYC steps) that would confirm the 'same week' framing. Missing for 10: explicit sign-up/underwriting approval process details, documented approval timeframes, and independent confirmation of end-to-end speed from signup to first live payment.
